title: A BLESSING
FOR YOUR HOME
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit dining table with open bible
soft morning light hitting olive branches
empty rustic kitchen table with window view
peaceful countryside home exterior at dawn
close up of bible pages with soft dust motes
tranquil living room with sunlight on wood floor

scenes.a: When the tension in your living room feels like it might break, choose stillness instead.
And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
Lord, anchor our family in this sacred promise that your tranquility flows through every single room.
Let no bitterness find a root here while we trust that your gentle presence remains enough.
Grant us the grace to overflow with this gift to every person who crosses our threshold.
